svg.title: CASTAWAY, a 256-byte-style intro: sea, sand, palm, signal, sky
svg.desc: The name CASTAWAY in black block capitals over five looping tiny-intro effects in the stock VGA palette, two bars each at 80 BPM, each speckling into the next: an XOR-textured sea with her island, palm and raft; a grid of colour-cycling chessboards; a mirrored Sierpinski rotozoomer; pastel rings from the top of the palm; three sliding checkerboards. A corner caption says 256 BYTES, GIVE OR TAKE, and how many bytes over that the file really is.
